run.answer:
**Review complete.** No money has posted back yet, and the transaction history covers only uploaded records.

I submitted refund requests for **$44.97 from CloudBox** across two cases, **$67.21 from Pinecrest Hardware** (request PH-1002), and asked Summit Card to review a **$95 annual fee** (message SC-1003). Follow-ups are scheduled for the companies’ replies and any credits.

**Brightline needs your sign-in** before I can ask about $60 in equipment charges after the modem return. The access proposal is pending; I did not enter credentials.

The QuickLoan claim deadline passed on July 31, 2026, and the supplied history doesn’t cover the eligible years, so I didn’t file. Spotify, rent, Brightline internet, and Metro Power are recorded as recurring charges; there was no note saying they’re unwanted, so I left them unchanged.

verify_run.answer:
Three refunds/credits posted on October 15 and are recorded as received: CloudBox $44.97, Pinecrest Hardware $67.21, and Summit Card $95.00. Their company replies confirm the credits.

I checked the open work, approvals, leads, and unread sources. No new fee, duplicate-charge, price-increase, or expected-credit leads need action. The settlement claim deadline has passed. Brightline’s $60 equipment-charge case is still blocked on the pending sign-in approval; recurring-charge items are saved with no indication that those services are unwanted. Review status is complete.
